content: प्रतिसंधानम् .²1 Joining together, uniting again; नैकोऽपि (उपायः) च्छिन्नकण्ठप्रतिसंधानपूर्वस्य प्राणलाभस्य <ls>Dk. 2. 2</ls>. .²2 The period of transition between two ages. .²3 A means, remedy. .²4 Self-command, restraint of feelings or passion. .²5 Praise. .²6 Memory, recollection. .²7 Remedy.
